body:
Sibling, one-area PR to #64 (M41-9 big-number + Art rulings, which supersedes #56). This PR supersedes nothing. I split it off so each PR stays one area: #64 is formatters and the order card, this one is the tracks-explainer card, focus ring and save notice. It is based on main dd223f5 and is independent of #64. UX-M4 (★ Best buy chip) is in **#62**.

**DO NOT MERGE** until HoE review, CCR, UI QA and Art sign-off on this SHA. HoE merges.

## Spec sources
- `art-ux/m4.1-ui-minors.md`: UX-M1, UX-M2, UX-M3, UX-M5 (UX-M4 → #62)
- `art-ux/number-pop-spec.md`: the refund pop (Sell style)
- `product/farm/frozen/m4a-spec.v1.24.md` §17: M4A-EXP-B4/B8. Its last bullet says the UX-M1/M3/M5 deltas replace B4/B8 when they land.

## Changes (6843443 + 6041522)
- **UX-M1** (`tracks-explainer.ts`, `styles.css`)
  - The focus target is unchanged (B-M1 order: active tab → bottom-nav Upgrades → #collect).
  - On an Esc/Enter or Got it close, the target gets `.kbd-focus`, because WebKit skips `:focus-visible` after a programmatic focus. The class is cleared on blur or the next pointer press.
  - The 3px `var(--c-focus)` #2B79A8 ring now applies to `nav.actions button`, `[data-tab]`, `#collect` `:focus-visible` and `.kbd-focus`.
  - A card-body tap or the 8 s timeout does not force the ring.
- **UX-M2** (new `src/ui/toast-safe.ts`, `app.ts`, `styles.css`)
  - `.save-warn` (the no-storage notice) is anchored at `--toast-safe-b`, which is viewport bottom − Collect top + 8px. On mobile that equals nav + Collect + 8.
  - The value is kept current on resize and by a ResizeObserver on Collect. It never goes below the old nav + 8 anchor.
- **UX-M3** (`tracks-explainer.ts`)
  - With the Upgrades sheet open, the card docks above the sheet: top = sheet top − card height − 8.
  - When that would go under the top bar, the card sits inside the sheet, 8 px below the tab row.
  - A sheet that doesn't share the card's columns (the docked 1280 panel) keeps the default spot.
  - The card is re-placed every frame while up, and `data-place` names the branch taken.
  - `placeExplainer()` is pure.
- **UX-M5** (`tracks-explainer.ts`, `styles.css`)
  - Close: the card still leaves the DOM at once, so `explainerOpen`, `EXP_CLOSED` and the focus hand-off are unchanged. An inert, aria-hidden copy (ids stripped) plays a 150 ms opacity + translateY(4px) out.
  - Refund > 0: a Sell-style number pop (`+$` compact, 16 px coin, #E8B020, 2 px #3E2C23 stroke, 26 px; 0.6→1.1→1.0 in 120 ms, rise 32 px to 500 ms, fade 500–800 ms) plus a coin particle, both aria-hidden.
  - Reduced motion (system setting or the in-game flag): neither the fade copy nor the pop. The close is instant.
- `tests/m41-9-ux-minors.test.ts` (16 tests) and `scripts/m41-9-uxm-shots.mjs`, which takes before/after shots: before = main dd223f5 dist-qa, after = HEAD dist-qa, with the build hashes checked.

## ACs → tests
| AC (Verify column) | Unit test | Browser (after; 3 engines) |
|---|---|---|
| UX-M1: Esc and Got it both show the ring, WebKit 360/375/390 | "UX-M1" ×4 (Esc, Got it + clear on blur/pointer, no ring on tap/timeout, CSS) | 6/6 per engine: focus `BUTTON[data-nav=upgrades]`, outline solid 3px rgb(43,121,168) |
| UX-M2: Collect fully tappable while the toast shows, 360 in 3 engines | "UX-M2" ×3 (formula, no-overlap property 560–1000 px, CSS/wiring) | 360 and 1280: notice rect clear of #collect, and a real Collect click adds eggs |
| UX-M3: every `[data-tab]` fully visible, 360/1280, sheet open | "UX-M3" ×5 (default/above/inside/docked + never-intersects property) | 4/4 per engine (plain and refund-line card × 360/1280): in view, no rect overlap, no 3×3 hit-test point lands on the card |
| UX-M5: 150 ms fade; refund pop + coin; reduced motion none | "UX-M5" ×4 (fade copy inert and gone after 150 ms, pop/coin gone after 800 ms, reduced motion system + flag, pop CSS) | 6/6 per engine: pop `+$1.2K` + coin, `expout` 150 ms, reduced motion with no fx at 360/1280 |

## Local gates at 604152226a21150a1d03dee44da72c049184b342 (CI is down)
- tsc --noEmit: PASS
- vitest (`--minWorkers=1 --maxWorkers=2`): **996/996** PASS
- `npm run build` + check-release-build: PASS
- `npm run build:html` + check-release-build: PASS
- sync-economy --check: PASS
- check-globals (flock lane 1): PASS

## Shots: `/workspace/wt-ui-shots/m41-9-6041522/`
- Produced by `node scripts/m41-9-uxm-shots.mjs <engine> /workspace/wt-m41-9-before-dd223f5`. AFTER = dist-qa `m3-rc1-pre+6041522`; BEFORE = dist-qa `m3-rc1-pre+dd223f5`.
- One engine per run, in flock lane 1 with timeout 600. All AFTER checks PASS: Chromium 18/18, Firefox 18/18, WebKit 18/18. Results are in `checks-<engine>.txt`.
- File names: `<engine>-UX-Mn-<before|after>-<state>-<w>x<h>.png`. The UX-M5 frames (`refund-pop-t000…t790ms`, `close-fade-t000…t149ms`, `reduced-motion-*`) are at 360 and 1280. They are taken by pausing the Web Animations at fixed currentTime values. Evidence only: the page's `remove()` on the decorative nodes is stubbed so they survive the frame grabs.
- BEFORE observations on main, every engine:
  - UX-M1: no 3px #2B79A8 ring after Esc/Got it.
  - UX-M2: the notice overlaps Collect at 360 and 1280.
  - UX-M3: the card with a refund line covers the tab row at 360.
  - UX-M5: no fade, no pop.
  - BEFORE was already OK for UX-M3 with the plain card at 360/1280 and with the refund line at 1280.
- An earlier run at 6843443 (`/workspace/wt-ui-shots/m41-9-6843443/`, WebKit only, exit 1) is superseded. Its UX-M3 check used "point lands on the tab", which fails on the pill's rounded corners even with nothing covering them. 6041522 replaces it with an occlusion test and adds the refund-line state.

## Spec conflicts / notes
1. **§17 B8 "Close: none" vs UX-M5.** I followed UX-M5, per §17's last bullet.
2. **UX-M3 fallback vs B4 (card never covers Buy).** At 360×640 there is never room above the sheet (sheet top 160 px), so the card takes the "inside the sheet below the tabs" branch and covers the top row, including its Buy button. I followed UX-M3, which §17 says replaces B4. Art should confirm this is acceptable at 360.
3. **UX-M5 reduced motion "no motion, instant" vs number-pop-spec reduced motion (150 ms fade-in, hold, 200 ms fade).** I followed UX-M5: no pop at all. The refund line still states the amount.
4. **Refund pop details number-pop-spec doesn't define.** There is no "refund" event, so I used Sell style and size (26 px). The origin is the refund line (the spec's Sell origin is above the coin counter). The pop is compact (`+$1.2K`) while the line is exact (`+$1,234.50`). The 8 px clamp from Buy/goal bar doesn't apply, since the pop is over the card.
5. **UX-M1.** Verify says "Got it shows the ring", so a pointer click on Got it also gets the ring on the target (`.kbd-focus`). Also, Playwright WebKit on Linux draws a thin UA "auto" ring before the fix, not none as on iOS. The before shots show that thin ring; after shows the 3 px #2B79A8 ring.
6. **UX-M2 says "toasts".** Only the bottom-anchored no-storage `.save-warn` sits near Collect. The main `.toast` is top-anchored (under the HUD or queue) and is unchanged. At 360 the moved notice now sits over the 44 px goal strip and meter. Neither is a ≥48 px primary, so the spec allows it.
7. M4-A data always refunds 0 (`migrationRefundCents`), so the refund pop is seeded through the QA handle in the shots.
title: M4.1 M41-9: Art Minors UX-M1/M2/M3/M5 (explainer focus ring, notice above Collect, card clear of tabs, close fade + refund pop)
